dogecoin.text:
Our team thinks storytelling is a huge edge.
Just look at Dogecoin.

A simple Litecoin fork with no groundbreaking tech.
Yet it built one of the strongest retail communities in crypto through humor and relatability.

This is where something like OlympusDAO failed.
They pioneered https://t.co/veY9xqVFZJ

Product-market fit isn’t dead. It’s just not enough. 
What gets traction isn’t always what works. It’s what feels timely, memeable, and aligned with the collective mood.  

→ Pudgy Penguins weren’t the “best” NFT tech. They just nailed the narrative. 
→ $DOGE didn’t win because https://t.co/XW7LmoozpU
